name: green-zone-series-offset
note: plotzone with a SERIES offset. `offset` was const-only, enforced by OS2023 (`offset= must be a compile-time constant`) -- an honest rejection, not a silent drop. That is what made the ICT suite's EQH/EQL misalignment unfixable in script: `ta.pivothigh` confirms a pivot `right` bars late, so a band spawning at the confirming bar sits `right` bars to the RIGHT of the candle that made the level, and the obvious `offset=-liqRight` would not compile because `liqRight` is a user input. Here `back` is an input (runtime, never const-folded) defaulting to 2, the zone spawns at bar 3, and x1 must be bar 1 -- not bar 3.
source:
indicator("H", shorttitle="H", overlay=true)
back = input.int(2, "Back", minval=0, maxval=10)
plotzone(bar_index == 3, high, low, "Z", offset=-back, extend=extend.bars, bars=1)
